d:
Yah 'kovid aveyarnes siriz' ka tisra vidiyo hai. ismen is vishay ki puri partal ki gaee hai ki plazma therepi kya hai aur ise hal hi men kovid-19 ke klinikal mainejment gaidlains se kyon hataya gaya hai?
'kovid aveyarnes siriz' ka uddeshy yah hai ki kovid ke sanbandh men jo aphvahen ya bhrantiyan hain, unhen dur kiya jae taki Pandemic ko Infodemic banne se roka ja sake. yah aasan bhasha men vaigyanik dharnaen spasht karte hue samaj ko nirasha aur duvidhaon se bachane ki pahal hai.
Isse pahle is siriz men do vidiyo aplod hue hain.
